title: The report values inventory as of the END of the selected range — the date is an as-of anchor, not a created-date filter
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. Nightly snapshots exist for past dates at the selected location (recording has been running).
3. A part exists that was ALREADY in stock before the selected range started.
custom_steps:
1. Select a past range (for example "Last Month").
2. Check which date the displayed values represent.
3. Look for the part that was stocked before the range started.
custom_expected:
1. The report values inventory as of the END of the selected range.
2. The date control is an "as of" anchor, not a created-date filter — narrowing it does not select "parts added in that range"; it shows the whole shelf as it stood on that date, so the part stocked before the range still appears.
